analyst_test: With every file conformed and every rule read, the easy route compares each area's median sale price, or its median price per square metre, or its type-by-type change weighted by the census stock, between the two years; but the dwellings that sold in each year are not the area's stock, and in some areas the year to September 2026 sold far more homes in the cheaper or the dearer electoral divisions, or far more new homes, so every summary of what sold moves with which homes sold, and only a hedonic regression of log price on the dwellings' type, floor area, new-dwelling status and electoral division, with a term for the year, gives the change in the value of an unchanged dwelling.
domain_test: An area's house price inflation measured the way official property price statistics measure it: sales are a changing sample of the dwelling stock, so the index is a constant-quality one, the time effect of a hedonic regression of log price on the dwelling's characteristics and location; with another field's nouns the step survives only where a price is read from a shifting sample of heterogeneous units whose attributes sit in another register.
layer2_pattern: own:an area's price change read from summaries of what sold when the sold homes are a shifting sample of the stock by location, size and newness
layer1: the price register in two layouts across the October 2025 system change
new-dwelling prices filed exclusive of VAT at 13.5 per cent
addresses joined to the valuation register by property number and to the address point file for the electoral division
sales not at full market price flagged and outside the index
stakeholder_role: head of price statistics at a national statistics office
driver: A unit's price change is read from the units of a heterogeneous stock that happened to trade in each period, and the traded mix shifts between periods by location, size and newness, with location held in a separate register; every summary of the traded units, raw, per unit of size or reweighted by a coarse type, moves with the mix, and only a regression of log price on the units' characteristics and fine location with a period term gives the change for an unchanged unit.
driver_concrete: Each area's sales in the year to September 2026 come from different electoral divisions, sizes and new estates than the year before; the median sale price, the median per square metre and the census-weighted change by dwelling type all move with that mix, and only the hedonic index with the electoral division from the address point file puts the right areas over 8 per cent.
stump: The default path compares each area's sales between the year to September 2025 and the year to September 2026 by dwelling type, weights the changes by the census stock and files the areas over 8 per cent, because it never asks whether the homes that sold within each type were the same kind of home in both years: in several areas the second year sold far more homes in the cheaper or the dearer electoral divisions, larger homes, or new homes at a premium, and only a hedonic regression on type, floor area, new-dwelling status and electoral division gives each area's change for an unchanged dwelling.

differentiation.task481: task481 restates counts onto a new classification by conversion rates from a dual-coded window; here no classification changes: prices of a shifting sample of dwellings are held to constant quality by regression.
differentiation.task470: task470 rebuilds activity a sensor never records from units it does; here every sale is recorded and the question is what the traded mix says about the stock's price.
differentiation.task251: task251 reads a unit's error over conditions its check never saw; here no instrument error: a price change for an unchanged dwelling.
differentiation.task479: task479 weighs noisy unit levels against the pool; here no shrinkage: each area's change is the time effect of a regression on the dwellings' characteristics.
differentiation.task464: task464 converts values across instruments by regression and counts units under a cut; here no instrument changes and no unit is converted: the regression holds quality fixed across two periods.
differentiation.task484: task484 counts occupied places when new places fill slowly; here new dwellings sell at a premium and the question is price, not occupancy.

A cost-by-level fit is natural to a strong reader once a credit hour file by level sits beside a consolidated return.
lineage.driver: A combined return reports one total for several units, and each unit's share is split by its head count, which gives every unit the group's average; but the item follows an activity whose unit cost differs several-fold across kinds, and the units inside the return do mostly the cheap kind, which the units that report alone measure, so the split by head count overstates the units inside and keeps them out of the lowest ranks.
lineage.stump: The default path splits each parent's instruction expense among the parent and its branches by FTE students and files 214506, 214682, 214858, 214946 and 215298 awarded, because it never asks whether a branch that teaches mostly lower-division credit hours costs what its system costs per student on average: the campuses that report alone show a lower-division credit hour costing under a third of a graduate hour, and three branches priced at the hours they teach have the lowest instruction expense per FTE in the state.
lineage.niche: a state higher-education coordinating board's 2027-28 instructional investment grant to the five public four-year reporting units with the lowest instruction expense per FTE student in fiscal 2026, from the federal finance and enrollment returns, where six branch campuses' finances are reported inside their parent campuses' returns

lineage.driver: A rate over a whole list is read from an audit of a sample drawn at very different rates for the members a screen flagged and the rest, and the flagged members carry the outcome far more often; the audited share overstates the rate wherever flagged members are a small part of the list, and only weighting each audited member by the inverse of its chance of being drawn, a chance recorded only in the screen's own output, recovers the list's rate.

lineage.driver: A cohort's median duration is read while part of the cohort is still running, and the still-running members are the slow ones; the median of the finished members understates it, and so does counting the unfinished at their age, so only the product-limit estimate that keeps each unfinished member at risk until its age recovers the cohort's median.
